name: shared_lib
detail: Pre-merge branch of upstream PR #19. Its end state landed on upstream main as 1a1bbfd (refactor: Shared lib #19), which the fork contains.
Harden node-serviced updates (open upstream). Squash-ported as f32806d; the fork then changed it in 2cf37a6, f4e8aa1 and e190d3d. See parity/DIVERGENCES.md.

PgBouncer and asyncpg prepared statements (panel#882), open upstream. Ported as 5f61243 after the docker test 602ed43 reproduced it (PgBouncer 1.23: 410 of 640 transactions failed on postgresql, 400 of 640 on timescaledb; 640 of 640 after the port). Not taken: the postgres:17-alpine pin, because fork installs run postgres:latest (18). See parity/DIVERGENCES.md. The fork also gives the panel user STATS_USERS instead of the pull request's ADMIN_USERS, so it cannot PAUSE or SHUTDOWN PgBouncer.
